13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally on the connector__ by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater.

14. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is __non-removably__ attachable to the flexible tube.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body includes a __thermally insulating multi-layered__ design.

18. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a __heated respiratory gas tube with integrated heating elements__.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes __a dedicated__ pressure measuring tube connection.

21. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an optional__ respiratory gas humidifier.

22. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via __a separate__ humidification line.

23. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a __separate flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube__.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a __spirally wound reinforced plastic material__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is __an electrical resistance heating element__.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage and is __positioned on the second portion such that__ both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion __extends radially outwardly from the first portion__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally on the connector__ by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion __extends radially outwardly from the first portion__.
